ActorTalk: Not many people in this building, but I'd rather not draw attention. Low profile is better.
Should we wait until the area clears before moving?
I'm not wasting the day here. You have business of your own to return to, don't you?
Keep it natural. Avoid groups. Match pace. Stay on course. It's straightforward.
Put simply, it's about who leads and who follows.
So the one following just... goes with the flow?
Exactly. So, what's it going to be? Taking point, or falling in behind me?
Tch. Fine by me. You are the commandant, after all. Humans are expected to lead their Constructs.
The route is yours, then. Move.
Good call. Just follow my lead.
